SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 09:43:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 09 and 10

		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 09:43:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

SELECT

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 14 and 15
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 14:35:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

"abor_security_type_name", "model_portfolio_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "portfolio_id", "ibor_reason", "abor_coupon_rate", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN (
    	select distinct exchange_name, mic, business_date, country_ref_code
    	from reference.reference_exchange_codes
    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
    ) rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,

        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,

        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,

        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,

        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,

        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,

        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,

        ss.abor_security_group_name,

        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1

        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN (
    	select distinct exchange_name, mic, business_date, country_ref_code
    	from reference.reference_exchange_codes
    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'

        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio

		SELECT *,

			SELECT abor_transaction_number,
				business_date,
				transaction_cancellation_flag,
				trade_date,

				SUM(CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
		 	FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
		 	GROUP BY abor_transaction_number,
		    	business_date,
		    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
		    	trade_date
		    )
    ) stc
        ON stc.latest = 1
        AND stc.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
        AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
        AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
        AND st.cost_or_tax_present = 'Yes'
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM JoinedData
WHERE rn = 1
AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active') AS "transactions_base"

WITH daily_returns AS (
                            SELECT
                                business_date,
                                time_weighted_return_local_currency,
                                LAG(time_weighted_return_local_currency, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS prev_return
                            FROM performance.scd_performance_bottom_up
                            WHERE dataset_id = 'SAP_C'
                              AND periods_per_year = '365'
                              AND pbor_node_id = 35
                            ORDER BY business_date ASC
                        ),
                        index_values AS (
                            SELECT
                                business_date,
                                100 * EXP(SUM(LN(1 + prev_return)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS index_value
                            FROM daily_returns
                        )
                        SELECT
                            distinct business_date AS businessDate, 
                            'DF_PE_FUNDS_SA_LOC' AS indexCode, 
                            index_value AS indexValue, 
                            'LOC' as currency
                        FROM index_values
                        ORDER BY business_date

    select business_date, rm_id, rm_value, rm_name, arrival_time,
        case
            when True and rm_name = 'cashRate' then date_add('day', 1, business_date)
            else business_date
        end as business_date_adj
    from market.tfm_risk_model_daily
    where business_date between date_add('day', -1, date '2025-06-16') and date '2025-06-16'
    and to_date(substring(cast(arrival_time as varchar), 1, 8), 'yyyymmdd') <= date '2025-12-31'
),
max_arrival_time as (
    select *,
        max(arrival_time) over (partition by rm_id, business_date_adj) as max_publish
    from date_adjusted
    where business_date_adj between date '2025-06-16' and date '2025-06-16'
)

from max_arrival_time

                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate

				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,

					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (

						ORDER BY date

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
),

has_dw_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT business_date, security_identifier, 'Y' as has_dw_transactions_y_n
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_capital_ledger_projections 
    WHERE 
        CAST(business_date as DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        AND CAST(expected_trade_date AS DATE) > CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-24'                           AS business_date
   , 'c796df42-dd9e-4d7c-9e15-c135e8db0109'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-25 13:30:44'                       AS extract_timestamp

   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group

   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount

   , NULL                                        AS pec_pipeline_y_n

   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy

   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_uat.ci_sentry_security, reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , '2025-06-24'        AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24' AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24'          AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24'  AS sentry_cashflows_all_transactions_business_date
   , '2025-06-24' AS sentry_dw_transactions_business_date
   , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(SEC.dc_opportunity_id,'') as BIGINT)    AS dc_opportunity_id     --BIGINT
   , coalesce(HAS_TRANS.has_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_transactions_y_n
   , coalesce(HAS_DW_TRANS.has_dw_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_dw_transactions_y_n

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN has_transaction_list  AS HAS_TRANS         ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_TRANS.security_identifier

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
),

has_dw_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT business_date, security_identifier, 'Y' as has_dw_transactions_y_n
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_capital_ledger_projections 
    WHERE 
        CAST(business_date as DATE) = CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
        AND CAST(expected_trade_date AS DATE) > CAST('2025-06-24' AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-24'                           AS business_date
   , 'c796df42-dd9e-4d7c-9e15-c135e8db0109'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-25 13:30:44'                       AS extract_timestamp
   , '2025-06-25T13:30:44.946123-04:00'              AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601
   , 'America/Toronto'             AS extract_timestamp_time_zone
   , NULL                                        AS account_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS scd_id
   , SEC.security_identifier                     AS security_identifier
   , SEC.issuer_identifier                       AS issuer_identifier
   , SEC.cppib_security_id                       AS cppib_security_id
   , ISSUER.cppib_entity_id                      AS sentry_issuer_id
   , NULL                                        AS source_data_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS sentry_security_id
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_code
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS deal_id
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS upstream_pipeline_number
   , SEC.security_name                           AS security_name
   , SEC.id_signal                               AS strategy
   , SEC.inv_group                               AS sub_strategy
   , SEC.security_name                           AS project_name
   , SEC.security_name                           AS investment_name
   , ISSUER.country_of_exposure                  AS country_of_exposure
   , SEC.currency                                AS funding_currency
   , NULL                                        AS deal_currency
   , SEC.private_vs_public                       AS private_vs_public
   , SEC.asset_category                          AS asset_category
   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating
   , SEC.asset_type                              AS asset_type
   , 'Credit Investments'                        AS investment_department_id
   , 'Active'                                    AS investment_status
   , 'Capital Call & Distribution Notices'       AS investment_lifecycle
   , NULL                                        AS deployment_disposition
   , ISSUER.gics_sector                          AS sector
   , NULL                                        AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local
   , NULL                                        AS funded_amount
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_net
   , COUP.maturity_date                          AS maturity_date
   , NULL                                        AS market_value
   , NULL                                        AS portfolio_name
   , SEC.sentry_security_type                    AS sentry_security_type
   , NULL                                        AS price_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS debt_factor
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_id
   , NULL                                        AS ticket_number
   , 80                                          AS probability_of_close
   , 'Binding'                                   AS binding
   , 'Net Purchases and Sales'                   AS capital_usage_component
   , NULL                                        AS transaction_cash_flow_type
   , 'Y'                                         AS send_to_treasury_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS expected_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_trade_date
   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price
   , SEC.expected_exit_probability               AS expected_exit_probability
   , SEC.expected_exit_date                      AS expected_exit_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm
   , NULL                                        AS unadjusted_exit_projection
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_by
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_date
   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group
   , NULL                                        AS created_by
   , NULL                                        AS date_updated
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount
   , NULL                                        AS fo_comments
   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals
   , NULL                                        AS pec_pipeline_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS fx_spot
   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm
   , NULL                                        AS rejected_deals_reason
   , NULL                                        AS investment_program
   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS comment
   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_uat.ci_sentry_security, reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , '2025-06-24'        AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24' AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24'          AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-24'  AS sentry_cashflows_all_transactions_business_date
   , '2025-06-24' AS sentry_dw_transactions_business_date
   , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(SEC.dc_opportunity_id,'') as BIGINT)    AS dc_opportunity_id     --BIGINT
   , coalesce(HAS_TRANS.has_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_transactions_y_n
   , coalesce(HAS_DW_TRANS.has_dw_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_dw_transactions_y_n

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN has_transaction_list  AS HAS_TRANS         ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN has_dw_transaction_list  AS HAS_DW_TRANS   ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_DW_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN coupon_list           AS COUP              ON SEC.security_identifier   = COUP.security_identifier

 FROM (

		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,

	WHERE

		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')

	client_ip

/* cppi::5a8d017d42011ca82ecc108040cfa2f7b52492bf51f2a099cef523b770a65621 */
SELECT aaa.*, bbb.cppib_party_id 
FROM 
(
	SELECT  
		a.symbol_type_id,
		a.symbol_type_name, 
		a.symbol_value, 
		a.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
		a.exchange_name, 
		a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, 
		a.periodtypeid, 
		a.fiscalquarter, 
		a.companyname, 
		a.companyid, 
		a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, 
		a.totalenterprisevalue, 
		a.sharesoutstanding, 
		sum(a.totaldebtoverebitda) as totaldebtoverebitda,
		sum(a.totaldebt) as totaldebt, 
		a.calendaryear, 
		a.calendarquarter,
		a.fiscalyear
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			st.symbol_type_id,
			st.symbol_type_name, 
			s.symbol_value, 
			ex.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
			ex2.exchange_name, 
			ct.tickersymbol,
			ct.primaryflag, 
			ex2.exchange_symbol, 
			fd.periodtypeid, 
			fd.fiscalquarter, 
			c.companyname, 
			mc.companyid, 
			mc.pricingdate,
			mc.marketcap, 
			mc.tev as totalenterprisevalue, 
			mc.sharesoutstanding,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4192 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebtoverebitda,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4173 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebt,
			fd.calendaryear, 
			fd.calendarquarter, 
			fd.fiscalyear
		from party.capiq_company c
		join (
			select
				fp.companyid, fp.periodtypeid, fp.fiscalquarter, fp.calendaryear, fp.calendarquarter, fp.fiscalyear,
				ic.financialinstanceid, fd.dataitemvalue, fd.financialcollectionid, fd.dataitemid,
				rank() over (partition by fp.companyid, fd.dataitemid order by fi.filingdate desc) rank
		    from party.capiq_ciqfinperiod fp 
    		join party.capiq_ciqfininstance fi 
			    on fi.financialperiodid = fp.financialperiodid
			join party.capiq_ciqfininstancetocollection ic 
			    on ic.financialinstanceid = fi.financialinstanceid 
			join party.capiq_ciqfincollectiondata fd 
				on fd.financialcollectionid = ic.financialcollectionid
			where
			    fp.periodtypeid = 4 		
			    and fp.latestperiodflag = 1
				and fi.latestfilingforinstanceflag = 1
				and fd.dataitemid in (4192, 4173)  -- 4173 = 'Total Debt' | 4192 = 'Total Debt / EBITDA'
		) fd 
			on fd.companyid = c.companyid and fd.rank = 1
		join party.capiq_ciqsymbol s
			on c.companyid = s.related_company_id
		join party.capiq_ciqmarketcap mc 
			on mc.companyid = c.companyid and mc.pricingdate = date'2025-06-03'
		left join party.capiq_ciqsymboltype st
			on s.symbol_type_id = st.symbol_type_id
		left join party.capiq_exchange ex
			on s.exchange_id = ex.exchange_id
		left join party.capiq_ciqtradingitem ct
			on st.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14) and s.object_id = ct.securityid and ct.primaryflag = 1
		join party.capiq_exchange ex2
			on ct.exchangeid = ex2.exchange_id
		where
			s.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14)
			and s.symbol_value is not null
			and s.active_flag = 1
			and s.symbol_end_date is null
	) as a
	group by
		a.symbol_type_id, a.symbol_type_name, a.symbol_value, a.exchange_symbol, a.exchange_name, a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, a.periodtypeid,
		a.fiscalquarter, a.companyname, a.companyid, a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, a.totalenterprisevalue, a.sharesoutstanding,
		a.calendaryear, a.calendarquarter, a.fiscalyear
) as aaa
join asset.asset_security_identifiers bbb
on bbb.business_date = date'2025-06-03'
	and ( (aaa.symbol_type_id = 3 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.cusip) or
          (aaa.symbol_type_id = 13 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.sedol) or
		  (aaa.symbol_type_id = 14 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.isin) )
where aaa.totaldebtoverebitda is not null

SELECT ticker,
       business_date as rate_date,
       price_source_code,
       cppib_sec_id,
       rate_type,
       from_currency_code,
       to_currency_code,
       mid_value,
       settlement_date,
       inverse_quoted_flag,
       tenor_code,
       null as derived_from,
       'N' as stale
FROM (
  select *,
         rank() over (partition by ticker order by price_source_code desc) rank
  from market.cppib_rates
  where business_date = date'2025-04-30'
        and price_source_code IN ('BGN London', 'WM Company')
        and mid_value is not null
)
WHERE rank = 1
UNION
SELECT ticker,
       rate_date,
       price_source_code,
       cast(cppib_security_id as integer) as cppib_sec_id,
       rate_type,
       from_currency as from_currency_code,
       to_currency as to_currency_code,

                  where business_date = (select max(business_date) from radar_reporting_uat.fact_fx_rate

                   where business_date = date'2025-04-30'

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (

			select

				, business_date 
				, node_name

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

	cross join unnest (

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

		, case

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

/* cppi::817fd621b65f403eee1d0daf758eba02bf8c898fd0714daae861598c5b16f9f3 */
SELECT 
        s1.model_portfolio_id as Account, 
        s1.abor_maturity_date as Maturity, 
        REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', '') AS Pair,
        SUM(s1.exposure_quotation_currency) as Ccy1, 
        SUM(s2.exposure_quotation_currency) as Ccy2
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main s1  
    JOIN holdings.scd_holdings_main s2 
        ON s1.model_portfolio_id = s2.model_portfolio_id 
        AND s1.abor_security_number = s2.abor_security_number
        AND s1.abor_maturity_date = s2.abor_maturity_date 
        AND s1.abor_holdings_leg_no <> s2.abor_holdings_leg_no
    WHERE 
        s1.model_portfolio_id in ('TFMFXCM', 'SUPPFXE', 'TFMFXCO')
        AND s1.quotation_currency_code = SUBSTR(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', ''), 1, 3)
        AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, CAST(s1.abor_maturity_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 21
        AND CAST(s1.business_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY
        AND CAST(s2.business_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    GROUP BY 
        s1.model_portfolio_id, 
        s1.abor_maturity_date, 
        REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', '')
    HAVING 
        ABS(SUM(s1.exposure_quotation_currency)) >= 10
        AND ABS(SUM(s2.exposure_quotation_currency)) >= 10
    ORDER BY
        s1.model_portfolio_id, 
        s1.abor_maturity_date, 
        REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', '')

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 15:46:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

with risk_hierarchy as (
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) as hierarchy_level,
		'RISK' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-06-24'
),
classification_secno as (select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class
			join risk_prod.dim_inst i on i.security_number = class.abor_security_number and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-06-24' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'abor_security_number'
			union
			select inst_id, cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industry_sector_name  
			from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite class 
			join risk_prod.dim_inst i on i.cppib_security_id = cast(class.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and i.business_date = cast(class.business_date as varchar) 
			where i.business_date = '2025-06-24' and class.esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
)
select 
	(
		case
			when dpi.portfolio_type in ('IP', 'CASH_FOR_BENEFIT', 'ACPP_CFB') then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH' then replace(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 'CPPSECID')
			when dpi.portfolio_type = 'LOOKTHROUGH' and position('OFFSET' in dpi.pos_source_system_key) > 0 then dpi.pos_source_system_key
			else concat(substr(dpi.pos_source_system_key, 1, position('_' in dpi.pos_source_system_key)-1), '_', dpi.pos_short_desc)
		end 
	) as "position_key",
	currency.iso_currency_code "DV01_currency",
	curve.curve_value "DV01_curve",
	curve_type.curve_type_value "DV01_curve_type",
	dv01.data_source "DV01_data_source",
	term.term_value "DV01_tenor",
	coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * dv01.final_value "DV01_cad_value",
	dv01.final_value,	
	dv01.initial_value,
	dv01.override_source,
	dv01.override_value,
	dv01.portfolio_type,
	dv01.scaling_type,
	dpi.maturity_date,
	dpi.pos_short_desc as "position_description",
	rh.model_portfolio as "scd_model_portfolio",
	rh.investment_dept,
	rh.investment_strat as "investment_strategy",
	rh.program as "investment_program",
	rh.sub_program as "investment_sub_program",
	dpi.cppib_product_type as "product_type",
	dpi.security_group_name as "product_group",
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.party_name is not null then i_rle.party_name
			when l1_rle.party_name is not null then l1_rle.party_name
			when mi_rle.party_name is not null then mi_rle.party_name
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_party_name,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.gics_sector is not null then i_rle.gics_sector
			when l1_rle.gics_sector is not null then l1_rle.gics_sector 
			when cl.industry_sector_name is not null then cl.industry_sector_name
			when mi_rle.gics_sector is not null then mi_rle.gics_sector
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_gics_sector,
	cpr.rating_value as "issuer_final_rating",
	csr.rating_value as "inst_final_rating",
	(
		case 
			when dpi.isin is not null then dpi.isin 
			when inst1.isin is not null then inst1.isin
			else inst2.isin
		end
	) as isin,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.sedol is not null then dpi.sedol 
			when inst1.sedol is not null then inst1.sedol
			else inst2.sedol
		end
	) as sedol,
	(
		case 
			when dpi.cusip is not null then dpi.cusip 
			when inst1.cusip is not null then inst1.cusip
			else inst2.cusip
		end
	) as cusip,
	(
		case 
			when i_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then i_rle.secm_exposure_country
			when l1_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then l1_rle.secm_exposure_country 
			when mi_rle.secm_exposure_country is not null then mi_rle.secm_exposure_country
			else null
		end
	) as issuer_country_of_exposure
from radar_reporting_uat.fact_pos_calc_md dv01
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_currency currency ON dv01.dim_calc_currency_id = currency.dim_calc_currency_id
	and dv01.business_date = currency.business_date
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_term term ON dv01.dim_calc_term_id = term.dim_calc_term_id
	and term.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'TERM'
	and dv01.business_date = term.business_date
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_curve curve ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_id = curve.dim_calc_curve_id
	and curve.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve.business_date
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_calc_curve_type curve_type ON dv01.dim_calc_curve_type_id = curve_type.dim_calc_curve_type_id
	and curve_type.CALC_DIM_TYPE = 'CURVE_TYPE'
	and dv01.business_date = curve_type.business_date
	join radar_reporting_uat.dim_pos_inst dpi ON dv01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
	and dv01.business_date = dpi.business_date
	left join radar_reporting_uat.fact_fx_rate fx ON currency.iso_currency_code = fx.to_currency
	and currency.chron_id = fx.chron_id
	and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
	and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'

                                      )

                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND

                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit

        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p

                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id

            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499

            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999

        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit

    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0

        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,

    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0

    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,
    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,

    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,

        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0

                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(

             FROM

                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE

                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'

                         OR EXISTS
                             (
                                 SELECT 1

                                     parent.business_date = sibling.business_date

     breaches_under_parents AS

                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE

        ELSE country_code

    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,

    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0

        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,
    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,

    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,

        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name
